fixes: Español is applied immediately when Save Language & Accessibility is clicked.
Language/accessibility preferences are cached locally before the network save.
Account save uses the approved RPC with a direct user-owned table fallback.
Spanish translation catalog is reloaded after save and after bootstrap.
Refresh preserves Language & Accessibility instead of overwriting the saved destination with Today while staged modules are still loading.
Dynamic safe pages retry their approved resume destination after the page mounts.
note: If the Build 6 database migration was never installed, same-device language persistence still works and the UI will report that account sync needs attention rather than silently reverting.
